Name: Pet Totoro
Author: magimatica
Description:
Hurlocks suggested I make a totoro cat replacer based on my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/867/?tab=4&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fcomments%2F%3Fthread_id%3D5314240%26mod_id%3D867]junimo-to-totoro mod[/url] :)

New to modding? Please read [url=http://canimod.com/for-players/intro]here[/url] for help.


Feel free to edit for your personal use, but please don't redistribute. This is the only official place to download this mod.
